title: ORM query call inside a for loop

possible-n-plus-one.message: An ORM query (`.objects.<method>(...)`) runs on every iteration of this loop, a possible N+1 query.
possible-n-plus-one.help: Prefetch the related rows before the loop (e.g. select_related/prefetch_related), or confirm this call is already cheap (cached, batched, or bounded).

metadata.source: Synthetic Django-style N+1 query example demonstrating ast.v1 structural matching.
